method: People served by the local water system is the largest EPA community water system (service area boundaries v3) whose area covers the site cell, or 0 where none does. Other facilities in the same HUC8 subbasin counts facilities from the same source and status in the USGS WBD subbasin of the site cell, as a measure of cumulative demand. The wetland share is vegetated NWI wetland (freshwater emergent, forested or shrub, and estuarine and marine wetland; lakes, rivers and ponds left out) and the flood zone share is FEMA special flood hazard area (A and V zones), each as the share of res-10 cells in the radius. Cooling water consumption is PNNL projected only. Few FracTracker records report a cooling source, so it is shown in the facility card and not scored. Baseline water stress (WRI Aqueduct) is not yet in the catalog. Scores are mid-rank percentiles (0–100) among the facilities in view, with direction applied so a higher percentile means a greater potential impact; tied values share the midpoint of their rank range, and a facility with no value for a variable is left out of that variable's ranking. The pillar score is the plain mean of the variable percentiles. Neighbourhood variables use the H3 res-8 cells (about 0.7 km² each) whose centre lies within the chosen radius of the facility; site variables use the single res-8 cell that holds the facility point. All of this is provisional.
